messages:
Maya R: quick morning check-in — short and focused
What I did: finished smoke run for model synapse-v1 (50 prompts), KV cache warmup looked fine.
Blockers: seeing truncation on long-context summarization cases (responses cut mid-sentence).
Today: update prompt set, run full 200-case eval, open PR for prompt tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/synapse/pull/42

Jon P: saw the smoke logs, thanks. can you paste one of the failing inputs/outputs?

Sasha K: here’s a failing example (trimmed):
```
INPUT: long article (1200 tokens) -> "Summarize in 3 bullets"
OUTPUT: "1. Key thing A. 2. Key thing B. 3. Key thing C. " <truncated>
```
Seems to drop after ~512 generated tokens.

Devin L: that smells like a decode/window issue or a KV-cache eviction when batching. Did the job use the same generation config as baseline? (temp/top-k, max_new_tokens)

Maya R: used same config as baseline: max_new_tokens=1024, temp=0.0. batch size 8 on dedicated GPU.

Devin L: can you re-run with debug flags and `--log-kv=true`? command I use: `python tools/eval.py \--model synapse-v1 \--prompts prompts/summarize-long.json \--batch 1 \--log-kv=true`
Also check quantization profile: we recently applied q4f16 for synapse-v1-lite and that changed token alignment in rare cases.

Olivia T: I can run full regression on Dedicated later today (slot at 16:00 PT). If it's infra-related we should catch it there. ping me once debug run is up.

EvalBot: AUTO: baseline vs synapse-v1 smoke: ROUGE-L -6.2%, avg_latency +12ms, regen_count flagged. Regression ticket created: RDW-5519.

Maya R: thanks EvalBot. assigning investigation to @Devin L, will update PR with failing example.

Jon P: quick FYI — small PR waiting for review that touches prompt templating (cr/1234). Might help the truncation by shortening system role notes.

Devin L: I’ll take CR/1234, add dataset tag `summarize_long_v2` and run local reproducer later today.

Sasha K: quick naming nit: can we standardize prompt files under `prompts/summarization/long/` with `v{n}` suffix? avoids confusion during rollouts.

Olivia T: yes please. If we rename, give me the list so I can update the canary jobs. I can canary the new prompt set tomorrow 10:00 PT if we have approvals.

Maya R: plan: 1) Devin runs debug -> posts logs, 2) I open prompt tweak PR (linked above), 3) Olivia schedules canary if green, 4) Sasha will rename prompt set after we land.

Jon P: sounds good. small test reminder — include the long-context harness (multi-paragraph) in the eval runner to avoid false negatives.

Maya R: will do. thanks all — I’ll ping channel when debug logs are up :thumbsup:
